{{Top}}
{{Quote|I told you to keep to the rocks, but, no, you had to walk over the 'nice soft sand.' I told you it was ''mucksand''!|[[Shae Koda]] to [[Tasha Ryo]]|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 3|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Quicksand''', also known as '''mucksand''', was a pit of loose or watery sand that would drown unsuspecting victims. There were many pits of quicksand on [[Kirdo III/Legends|Kirdo III]], and quicksand was also found on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Dractu]], and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="game11">''[[Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea]]''</ref>
